reason: My spot already knows my order and I'm in and out in two minutes before the 1 train. I might take a free sip of the matcha walking past, but I'm not swapping my daily coffee for an $8.50 dessert latte.
objection: I already have a coffee place on my route, and these signature drinks sound like weekend-tourist sugar bombs rather than something I'd drink every morning.
would_change_my_mind: If my usual place closed or got slow, or if the plain matcha tasting was genuinely better than anything near me, I'd give the $8 matcha a real try.
